steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: ...You don't need to bother yourself with this, Talulah. The tractor's been missing for months. They were probably stopped by the Patrol Unit. There's not much we can do about it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Even if all we can do is find their bodies, we'll at least be giving their families some closure.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: If the intel recon gave us is correct, this should be the area where they'd gone missing.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Talulah, snap out of it! Everything they said is just a load of horseshit.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: They're just a bunch of heartless bastards... Don't let it get to you!

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: None of them had the willpower to keep going, to leave the tundra! They fought so many battles with you, and they thought you a coward?! You're the most fearless soldier among us!

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Talulah, trust me. All of us follow you by will!

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Captain Buldrokkas'tee used to be an Ursus soldier, but we all know he's the most steadfast man we have! All of us trust him!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Not necessarily. He's strong. Way too strong. Stubborn, too. The people who didn't trust him were just afraid to speak up.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It only takes a brief moment for trust to completely crumble. If all the people who followed Patriot died one day, would the ones who come after them be as steadfast as them?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Rumors can destroy us. Before there are rumors, those who are innocent are innocent, and those who are skeptical of others are also innocent.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But no one is innocent once rumors begin to spread.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: But what does your upbringing has to do with anything?! You've done so much for all of us!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's fine. Calm down.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Besides, I haven't really done all that much for them.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Come on, don't say that.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Are you sure you want to go by yourself? Faust has been tagging along with those crossbow guys lately, and he's really getting the hang of it. If the guerrillas aren't around, you could bring them with...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Protecting the Infected traveling with us is our top priority. We aren't fighting this war just to fight a war. Our goal is to help our fellow men survive. Don't put the cart before the horse.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Protecting them is our top priority.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Know this by heart, and make sure everyone else does as well.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Well... godspeed.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Don't worry. It's just negotiating with the locals. Everything will be fine.
At a nearby village.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Before, I probably would've just run inside and started asking questions right away.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I wonder when did I become like this.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hiding and sneaking around... It was just being suspicious and cautious at first, but this is practically antagonizing everyone now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not even sure if it is unexpected things that I'm worried about or a repeat of those tragedies.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What a rundown place. Looks like they didn't have much of a harvest this year. Everyone looks so tired.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Weird. It should've been a while since the last time this village resettled, but there's a lot of tractor marks around the village's entrance.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There are scraps at the assembly workshop... but I don't think they're from the village's old tractors. The authentication box is gone. If the vehicle belonged to the village, there's no reason to take that out...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's getting dark. I should take a look at the junkyard.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This is weird. There's your household garbage, but there isn't much else.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No equipment for processing spent Originium here? If it's not in the junkyard, then where?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's winter, so there should be wheat straws and warming grass husks everywhere. Did they run into food problems?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...No... that's not right. They burned them. I need to check out their granary.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What's this? What... What happened here?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There's Originium residue all over the place... and the ground is dug up all over the place.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Claw marks... on the granary's door—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Ahh—!
Who's there?!
Talulah turns around.
She finds an Ursus farmer standing there with his guard up. The farmer notices how Talulah is dressed and sets his shovel down.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Geez... what's the matter with you, coming inside the village without saying a word?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Haven't ever seen you before... Are you from the Gendarmerie?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: You aren't here for the rent, are you? We already paid our Originium tax. Hell, the taxman took our food too while he was at it. There isn't much more we can pony up.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm here since I'm investigating the Infected.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Oh, Infected? We don't have any here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Has any Infected passed by?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We received a message. I know there's been Infected here. If you know what's good for you, spill it.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Urgh, can't fool you, eh.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Those scumbags. They said no one knew they were passing through here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So they were here.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Damn right they did. They had those scary weapons on them. Scared the life out of us!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: We didn't have the guts to go against them, and we didn't try to.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: After that, they even took all of our food, those bastards! Please, you have to get these Infected... these criminals for us!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's not right.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's not right...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How dare you say that?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How dare you say that...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How dare you say that!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: What's the matter with you, ma'am?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You heard their cries!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You heard them crying out for help...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You heard them clawing at the door with their fingers!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: W-What are you... ma'am...

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: You right in the head?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Hey, over here!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Any of you seen her before? Where is she from?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Right, I haven't ever heard an accent like that before!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: ...Yeah, that's right! She doesn't have a mask on... If she was here to investigate the Infected, she'd be all decked out in protective equipment!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Answer me!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Infected.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Just like the people you murdered, I'm an Infected.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: We've done nothing wrong.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You locked them in here. You let them die here.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: What are we supposed to do? We don't even have any food left for ourselves!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You could've chased them away or just never allowed them in... You could've just attacked them or outright killed them, and I wouldn't be here complaining to you right now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But you tricked them. You lured them into your empty storehouse, locked the doors, and starved them.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They were so hungry, they couldn't even use their Arts... They were here only to panhandle. They weren't here to attack you. They didn't even have the strength to fight back. They were just normal people.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Normal? Those Infected? Don't make me laugh!

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Who are you to reason with me, you Infected scumbag? You're just a freak!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You kept the storehouse locked until the Originium crystals stabilized. Then you disposed their bodies with the dried up Originium...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They had families, they had friends, they had places they wanted to be... There's not even anything left of them. Infected often die and leave no traces left of their existence behind. That happens way too often, but now there isn't even a way for us to find out where their ashes have gone.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: What are we supposed to do? It's not like we've got much to feed ourselves! Life's not easy for us either!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Then why did you lie to them?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: How could we have known what was going to happen to them? And what were we supposed to do?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's just an excuse. You saw them starving... You knew they had no weapons to fend themselves with.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You did this because it was... convenient.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: From the beginning, you never... No, actually... Ha.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Even if they weren't Infected, you would've done the same thing.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: (Time to get rid of her. Get the sentries!)

a.text: You will come to see. These great lands you threw yourself to do not want you.

steps.text: No. No.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Then what do you want? Look, it's all in the past. We'll even apologize.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: We can pretend you've never been here, just like those other folks were never here... All you have to do is walk away.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Who do you even think they were?

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: Huh? Whatever you are, that's what they were.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You thought them weak, and in that case, that makes me a weakling who knows not how to fight back.

steps.name: Ursus Farmer
steps.text: ...Ugh... Just get out of here already. We don't want no trouble here!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They were here, begging at your feet, and what did you do?

a.text: You will see your thoughts, your actions, become nonexistent.

steps.text: No.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're despicable.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There will be no peace in this world while people like you still walk it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The Infected patrols haven't been to your village in three years.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The noble family that controlled the settlements here died long ago during the Great Rebellion. Everything teetered on the edge of chaos, and your village has been left untended for years.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And yet... you killed all those people even though you had nothing to gain from their deaths.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If you had even a tiny bit of kindness in you... you would've let them go. The whole village heard their cries, but none of you did anything until they died, one after another.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If you still had any decency in you, you wouldn't have done anything this wretched.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I hate you.

a.text: You will see them spurn all you revered, your life, your dignity and philosophy void of all significance.

steps.text: No!!
